title: 03704 - B10B3/037043
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Function Restriction due to Implausible Message(s) from other Control Module(s)
Fault Code stored in other Control Module(s)
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Resolve Fault Codes in other Control Module(s) first
technicalNotes: Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Vehicles with VW Airbag Generation VW8R or VW10G, Kontrol edin: ABS / ESP Fren Elektroniği Control Module (J104/#03) for Fault Code 01486. If this Fault Code 01486 is stored, make sure to Gerçekleştirin: the System Function Test for the ABS / ESP Fren Elektroniği first. Once the System Function Test is successful the Fault Code in the Airbag Control Module can be cleared.
